images.name: ヌルミィ
images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent pixel-art sprite atlas for an original Japanese creature-collecting RPG named Pachi Monsters. Create ONE creature in TWO independently drawn battle views on a 2:1 landscape transparent canvas: LEFT HALF full-body front three-quarter view facing screen LEFT; RIGHT HALF full-body rear three-quarter view facing screen RIGHT, showing the back of head and body, not a flipped front. Equal square cells, generous transparent margins, no sprite pixels crossing the vertical midpoint. Both views same creature, scale and proportions, with feet on the same baseline. Style: exceptionally polished hand-placed 16-bit / 32-bit Japanese RPG pixel art, native-like 128x128 pixel logic per pose enlarged with crisp square pixel clusters, subtle palette ramps, strong readable silhouette, clean dark outline, dense deliberate shading. No smooth illustration, vector edges, blur, lettering, labels, watermark, background, ground, cast shadow, interface, checkerboard or decorative frame. The evolutionary family is an original mysterious void-type glitch creature with an ink-navy and smoky-violet body, pale cyan highlights, small warm white eyes, a distinctive broken empty ring motif and small detached square pixel fragments; cute yet eerie, no existing franchise character. Stage 1, Nullmie (ヌルミィ): a tiny adorable round ghost-kitten with short triangular ear tufts, large curious pale cyan eyes, a soft light-gray face mask, little feet and mitten paws. A slim tail curls into a broken empty ring behind it. A few sparse pixel chips drift from the tail tip. It has a compact baby silhouette and a short smoky shawl; no horns, no armor. The rear view has ears, rounded head, shawl and the broken ring tail; NO eyes on its back.
